plugin.seo.toolkit.sitemap.error.name: SEO Toolkit Error
plugin.seo.toolkit.sitemap.error.message: Lucid toolkit could not build the sitemap.
plugin.seo.sitemap.disabled: The sitemap is turned off in the SEO plugin's options.
plugin.seo.sitemap.site.url.missing: Set siteUrl in your Lucid config, so the sitemap can build absolute page URLs.
plugin.seo.sitemap.routing.missing: Sitemap collection '{{collection}}' has no routing, so its pages have no paths to list. Add routing, such as with the pages plugin, or leave it out of the sitemap's collections.
plugin.seo.sitemap.environment.unknown: '{{environment}}' isn't an environment of any collection.
plugin.seo.sitemap.environment.ambiguous: Cannot tell which environment the sitemap lists, because collections end in different environments: {{environments}}. Pass an environment, or set the SEO plugin's sitemap environment.
plugin.seo.sitemap.documents.fetch.faile: Could not read the '{{collection}}' pages for the sitemap.
plugin.seo.sitemap.entry.invalid: A seo.sitemapEntries hook returned an invalid sitemap entry: {{issue}}
plugin.seo.sitemap.entry.offsite: A seo.sitemapEntries hook returned {{url}}, which isn't on a configured site URL's origin ({{origins}}). A sitemap can only list its own site's pages.
plugin.seo.sitemap.file.clash: Two sitemap files are named '{{file}}'. Rename a collection, or give the hook's entries another file.
plugin.seo.sitemap.empty: The sitemap lists no pages on this site origin, so it has no index.
plugin.seo.toolkit.robots.error.name: SEO Toolkit Error
plugin.seo.toolkit.robots.error.message: Lucid toolkit could not write robots.txt.
plugin.seo.robots.disabled: robots.txt is turned off in the SEO plugin's options.
plugin.seo.robots.site.url.missing: Set siteUrl in your Lucid config, so robots.txt knows which site it is for.
plugin.seo.origin.unknown: '{{origin}}' isn't one of the configured site origins: {{origins}}.
plugin.seo.index.now.disabled: IndexNow is turned off in the SEO plugin's options.
plugin.seo.index.now.urls.failed: Could not read or store the pages to send to IndexNow.
plugin.seo.index.now.send.retry: IndexNow could not take the changed pages for {{host}} ({{reason}}). They're sent when the job tries again.
plugin.seo.index.now.status.error.name: IndexNow Status Error
plugin.seo.index.now.status.error.messag: Could not read the pages waiting for IndexNow or the last send.
plugin.seo.toolkit.index.now.error.name: SEO Toolkit Error
plugin.seo.toolkit.index.now.error.messa: Lucid toolkit could not queue the IndexNow send.
